notes: Question probes against the offline Grandma (review 44, docs/10-design-rescore.md). 'reach': a route the chain maps promise must work (checked by Vitest). 'obvious': the ten most direct questions per puzzle, asked by someone who has only read the note (and knows their own family), so no question already contains a hop's answer; the report says how often one reply hands over a whole answer part (deduction depth, rubric dimension 1). Questions from the independent review of 2026-11-16. Since the note generator (docs/15), 'obvious' is per part: a note is probed with the questions of both its parts (union of the lists the eight old notes had).
